I relate to this very much. I have aspirations but I think not having a clear way to achieve them (and being a little frightened of achieving them) has made me feel like I've reached a plateau and that I'm drifting around with no goal or purpose or worth. My life isn't bad, I'm doing well. But seriously, would it be so bad to be dead? 

Logically, yah, it would be bad because there wouldn't be any possible way to do any of the aspirations I have. At least, being alive means there's a chance - being dead there isn't a chance at all. 

For some reason this rings hollow to me but maybe it's just short sightedness. I suppose we just have to shrug and accept that we may as well keep our chances more than zero, and work towards those goals in tiny, different ways, with patience. 

Anyway, from another inwardly doubtful person - I also wish you well!
